name: Brand24
description:
Bring your Brand24 insights directly into Claude

The Brand24 app in Claude gives you instant access to social listening insights through simple conversations. Instead of digging through dashboards, exporting reports, or manually analyzing mentions, you can ask Claude questions about your brand, competitors or campaigns and get answers based on your Brand24 data. 

Whether you're a marketer, PR specialist, agency, or analyst, Brand24 app helps you turn online conversations into actionable insights in seconds.

What can you ask Claude:
1. "What's the current sentiment around my brand?" - Instantly understand how people feel about your brand and identify the topics driving positive or negative conversations.
2. "Summarize my project from the last 30 days." - Get a concise overview of key trends, spikes in mentions, sentiment changes, and the most important discussions.
3. "Compare my brand with competitors." - Analyze share of voice, sentiment, reach, and discussion volume across multiple brands without building reports manually.
4. "What caused this spike in mentions?" - Quickly identify the events behind sudden increases in visibility.

Brand24 app makes Claude more than just an AI assistant - it becomes a powerful source of real-time brand, market, and competitor intelligence powered by your Brand24 projects.

prompts: What are the main discussions in the project?
Analyze sentiment statistics of the project

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brand24 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brand24 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.brand24.com/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brand24 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brand24 provides these MCP tools: brand24_account_events, brand24_project_stats, brand24_project_sources, and brand24_topics_overview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brand24?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brand24 in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Brand24 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brand24 is developed by Brand24 Global Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
